description: Land Title Settlement Department - Danawalagama, Neluwa D/S Division, Galle District - Cad. Map No. 810653 (22/0838)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including parcel numbers, extents, ownership details, and legal status. The content focuses on land registration, title settlement, and property ownership determinations, which clearly falls under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it primarily concerns land and property-related administrative matters.
